column1: # The optional 5th column narrows an entry to ONE sub-unit of the file — for
# the module sweep, one of spthy/spthytyped/msr. Left empty (or absent) the
# entry covers every row of the file, so a file ledgered for `msr` only still
# reports a fresh `spthy` divergence as DIFF.
#   stderr-oracle-calls    HS derivation checks invoke the theory's oracle
#                          heuristic and emit ">>>> START ... Oracle call"
#                          stderr blocks; RS deriv checks never call oracles.
#   capacity               RS aborts (rc 134, stack/OOM at the 16GiB guard) or
#                          both sides exhaust the 600s retry cap.
#   hs-timeout             HS cannot load the file inside the cap while RS
#   replay-empty-json      csf26-ac stored-proof replay diverges to sorry
#                          emits the empty 20-byte document vs HS's graphs.
#   sapic-export-echo      sapic/export corner files whose -m echo/rc diverged
#                          lines on stderr that RS does not.
#   oracle-timeout         the HS oracle cannot produce a reference inside
#                          the 600s serial retry cap (rc hs=124); the sweep
#                          then skips the RS side, so the row has nothing to
#   stderr-open-chains     the derivation-check "[Open Chains] Too many chain
#                          constraints" warning is emitted a different NUMBER
#                          of times by the two sides (beyond the consecutive
#                          stdout agrees and the plain load path shows the
#                          same counts, so no flag is involved.
#   hs-derivcheck-timeout  HS's Maude-backed derivation check exceeds
#                          HS's wf report carries the "Derivation checks timed
#   hs-parse-rejects       HS's parser rejects the file ("Invalid pattern")
#                          where RS parses it — permissive divergence, so rc
#                          and stderr differ in every module.
# SAPIC translator/renderer gaps — REAL pre-existing divergences (PRE-binary
# confirmed at main@a722d92, byte-identical there), ledgered so the sweep is
# signal-clean; the fix roster lives in the campaign notes:
#   sapic-eq-pattern       `=x` equality pattern in a let destructuring is
#                          rebound as a fresh variable (rule arity changes,
#   sapic-skey-sort        `:skey` sort annotation dropped from process
#   sapic-wf-text          RS's SAPIC wf/typing failure text is unported
#   sapic-wf-missing       RS misses a SAPIC wf finding HS reports (lock over
#   pred-wrapping          long predicate/if argument lists are not
#                          width-wrapped as HS's HughesPJ layout wraps them.
